title: OVERFLOW
tagline: Let God's hope overflow in you.
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

session.prompt: Memorize Romans 15:13 up to here: "May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you may overflow with hope," (New this week: "so that you may overflow with hope.")

coaching_notes: It's the small things no one sees that lead to the big results everyone wants. Be faithful in the little things — even memorizing Scripture.
